name: Brand Safety Check on Application
description: When a creator applies via the public form, automatically run a brand safety check on their social profiles and flag any concerns in the admin dashboard.

then.prompt: A new creator application was just submitted. Check if the creator's profile URL is accessible, run a quick brand safety assessment based on their platform and handle, and note any red flags (controversial content, fake followers, competitor associations). Add findings to the creator's notes field.
